name: Disc Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: a round portable CD player with its teal lid up, pink lens eyes and a W-shaped grin on the lid
entry: It spins its disc so fast the air around it chills. It only plays the songs it likes.
how: Use a Compact Disc on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Ice Beam in this form.
